# Lexmedix

> Radbank, Fullcurebank, Pathbank, Treatbank, Legalbank and Facility Management SaaS: six AI apps that turn what you say or upload into finished, checked work. Plus Dxbank, offline lab and radiology software with an NABL and NABH evidence dashboard and evidence pack. From ₹300 per user per month.

Website: https://lexmedix.in/
Founder: Dr Sudhanshu Bankata
Earlier name: Bankata.AI (the same business; the current name is Lexmedix)

## Products

- [Dxbank](https://lexmedix.in/dxbank/): One program for your lab and imaging centre, with an NABL and NABH evidence dashboard built in.
- [Facility Management SaaS](https://lexmedix.in/facility-management/): Attendance, payroll, billing and cleaning quality for housekeeping companies, even when workers have no smartphone.
- [Fullcurebank](https://lexmedix.in/fullcurebank/): Consultations, ward rounds and discharges, written as you work.
- [Legalbank](https://lexmedix.in/legalbank/): Cases, documents and arguments in one AI workspace for the whole legal team.
- [Pathbank](https://lexmedix.in/pathbank/): Upload a lab report. Get a clear reading, the flags and the trend.
- [Radbank](https://lexmedix.in/radbank/): Dictate only what is abnormal. Radbank writes the rest of the report.
- [Treatbank](https://lexmedix.in/treatbank/): A pile of old prescriptions and reports, turned into one clean patient history.

## Pages

- [Pricing](https://lexmedix.in/pricing/): One price per user, with AI included. Plans for Radbank, Fullcurebank and Pathbank, and quotes for Treatbank, Legalbank, Facility Management SaaS and Dxbank.
- [Additional Services: consulting led by Dr Sudhanshu Bankata](https://lexmedix.in/services/): Radiology reporting through RadBank Imaging Solutions, NABH and NABL radiology readiness, hospital consulting, websites, medical editing and custom digital tools for doctors, labs and hospitals.
- [About Dr Sudhanshu Bankata](https://lexmedix.in/about/): Lexmedix was founded by Dr Sudhanshu Bankata: MBBS (Maulana Azad Medical College), MD Radiology (UCMS Delhi), PGP (Indian School of Business), NABH and NABL assessor, former hospital executive director and MD and CEO of RadBank Imaging Solutions.
- [Contact](https://lexmedix.in/contact/): Book a demo, ask about pricing or get product updates for any Lexmedix product.
- [Security and patient privacy](https://lexmedix.in/security/): How Lexmedix products protect patient records, reports and case files: separate data for every organisation, role-based access, encryption and links that expire.
- [Privacy](https://lexmedix.in/privacy/): How the Lexmedix website handles the details you send.
- [Terms](https://lexmedix.in/terms/): Terms for using the Lexmedix website.
